# viettelcloud_dbc_cluster (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud DB cluster by ID, name, engine, region or status. Set at least one, and exactly one cluster must match. A name is unique per project and engine, so name with engine selects one cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup a DB cluster by ID
data "viettelcloud_dbc_cluster" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Lookup a DB cluster by name and engine. A name is unique per project and
# engine, so the pair selects one cluster.
data "viettelcloud_dbc_cluster" "by_name" {
  name   = "example-mongodb"
  engine = "mongodb"
}

# Narrow the lookup to one region
data "viettelcloud_dbc_cluster" "by_name_and_region" {
  name   = "example-opensearch"
  engine = "opensearch"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `engine` (String) Database engine to filter by: cassandra, memcached, mongodb, opensearch, starrocks or timescaledb.
- `id` (String) DB cluster ID (UUID). Exactly one cluster must match.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the DB cluster to filter by.
- `region` (String) Project region name of the cluster to filter by.
- `status` (String) Status of the cluster to filter by, such as active.

### Read-Only

- `admin_username` (String) Username of the administrator account.
- `allowed_cidrs` (Set of String) IPv4 CIDR blocks that may connect to the cluster.
- `auto_backup_config` (Attributes) Automatic backup schedule, or null when the cluster has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto_backup_config))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the cluster was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the DB cluster.
- `enable_auto_backup` (Boolean) Whether automatic backup is enabled.
- `enable_auto_increase_volume_size` (Boolean) Whether the backend grows node volumes automatically.
- `enable_pitr_backup` (Boolean) Whether point-in-time recovery is enabled.
- `enable_public_access` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is reachable from the internet.
- `enable_ssl` (Boolean) Whether connections use SSL.
- `endpoint` (Map of String) Connection endpoint that the backend reports. A value that is not a string is encoded as JSON.
- `engine_config` (Attributes) Engine settings, or null for an engine without settings. Only memcached has settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engine_config))
- `engine_version` (String) Engine version of the cluster.
- `error_message` (String) Error message of the last failed operation.
- `keep_backup` (Boolean) Whether backups are kept when the cluster is deleted.
- `maintenance_config` (Attributes) Weekly maintenance window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_config))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form string metadata.
- `node_pools` (Attributes List) Node pools of the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pools))
- `operational_status` (String) Operation that the backend is running on the cluster, or noop.
- `plugins` (Set of String) Names of the installed plugins.
- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet that the cluster connects to.
- `subnet_name` (String) Name of the subnet that the cluster connects to.
- `topology` (String) Topology of the cluster.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the cluster was last updated (RFC3339).
- `vpc_name` (String) Name of the VPC of the subnet.
- `zone` (String) Zone name, or null for a multi-zone cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--auto_backup_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto_backup_config`

Read-Only:

- `backup_interval` (String) Backup interval: daily or weekly.
- `day_of_week` (String) Day of the week of a weekly backup.
- `enable_auto_backup` (Boolean) Whether automatic backup is enabled.
- `max_auto_backup` (Number) Number of automatic backups to keep, or null for an engine that keeps backups by age.
- `retention_days` (Number) Number of days to keep automatic backups, or null for an engine that keeps backups by count.
- `start_hour` (Number) Hour of day that the backup starts.


<a id="nestedatt--engine_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engine_config`

Read-Only:

- `auth_enabled` (Boolean) Whether clients must authenticate.
- `mcrouter_routing_type` (String) Routing of the mcrouter mode: sharded or replicated.
- `mode` (String) Memcached mode: direct or mcrouter.


<a id="nestedatt--maintenance_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenance_config`

Read-Only:

- `day_of_week` (String) Day of the week.
- `start_hour` (Number) Hour of day that maintenance starts.


<a id="nestedatt--node_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pools`

Read-Only:

- `disk_size` (Number) Volume size of each node in GB.
- `engine_roles` (Set of String) Engine roles of the pool.
- `id` (String) Node pool ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Name of the node pool.
- `node_count` (Number) Number of nodes in the pool.
- `partition_count` (Number) Number of partitions, which is the shard count for mongo_sharding.
- `pool_config` (Attributes) Engine-specific settings of the pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pools--pool_config))
- `replicas` (Number) Number of replicas in the pool.
- `resource_config` (String) Name of the resource package of each node.
- `role` (String) Role of the pool in the topology.
- `storage_class` (String) Name of the storage class of the node volumes.
- `used_disk_size` (Number) Used volume space of each node.

<a id="nestedatt--node_pools--pool_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pools.pool_config`

Read-Only:

- `attribute` (String) Storage tier of the pool.
